name: Leura Village & Gardens
blurb: A pretty mountain village of cafés and gardens, a short walk from the cliffs.
weatherNote: Cooler than the city, so good on hot days. The cafés and shops make a wet day work too.
gettingThere: Blue Mountains Line to Leura. The village starts at the station.
newcomerTip: Easy to pair with Echo Point, one stop on. Walk down to Leura Cascades for a quick taste of the bush.

back.text: From Gordon Falls, walk back up to Leura station (≈ 25 min), or catch bus 695 from Balmoral Rd to Katoomba station when it runs (it's infrequent). Trains to Central run roughly hourly: check the last one.

notes: Parking on the Mall is time-limited. Side streets are easier.

routes.ride: Not practical: it's a long, expensive ride. The train is the easy option.

visit.bestTime: Spring for blossom, autumn for colour. Any clear day works.
visit.hours: Village shops about 9am to 5pm. Lookouts always open. Everglades House & Gardens opens 10am to 4pm (last entry 3pm), closed Tuesdays.
bring: A warm layer: it's cooler than the city
visit.access: The Mall is flat and paved. The Cascades track has steep steps.
safety: Stay behind railings at the lookouts
Check NSW National Parks alerts before walking tracks
